_comment: Hand edits for tools/extend_deck_korean.py (ranks 5001+ only). _drop removes a lemma; _add forces a lemma in with the given gloss/pos/posName (used for one-syllable words, which the extender otherwise rejects, and for words the dictionaries gloss badly); every other key overrides gloss / pos / posName / reading for that lemma.
